items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: This is the trumpet player. Alvin talked about him.

ctx.x: That trumpet player. I knew Kimball was that. Did you know him? I knew Kimball was bass player. No. No.
This is the trumpet player. Alvin talked about him. Alvin Alcorn. I think he was, but I think he worked later on with Rosesh.
They could have been before Alvin joined your band and after you'd left town if you'd come out. Hey.
